mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 4.5% indicates tightening monetary policy, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when HOUST (housing starts) rises > 5% MoM and RSAFS (retail sales) grows > 2% YoY, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST MoM growth > 5% and RSAFS YoY growth > 2%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: in late-cycle expansions, a 2% MoM increase in INDPRO (industrial production) signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of late-cycle instances with INDPRO MoM growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: high FEDFUNDS (> 3.5%) and low CPIAUCSL (< 290) together predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to monetary policy mismatch.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a sudden 0.5% increase in UNRATE within 2 months signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances with UNRATE increasing > 0.5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: concurrent GDPC1 growth > 1.5% YoY and PAYEMS growth > 1% MoM predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, indicating robust economic expansion.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > 1.5% and PAYEMS MoM growth > 1%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.035 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
